entries.title: First public release
entries.body: 33 modules in five parts, formula sheet, interview collection and MATLAB/Octave scripts. Before release every module was audited claim by claim (about 1,400 claims checked; wrong and imprecise statements fixed and the fixes re-verified). The 57 claims that audit could not confirm were rechecked against primary sources on 26 October 2026: 32 confirmed, 9 corrected, 12 reworded or removed; the 3 items below are still open.
